verdict.rationale: Postman documents workspace 'versioning' and team review mechanisms (comments, live sessions, roles/permissions) that could support reviewing automations, but there is no explicit documented rollback/version-history feature for collections or automations, and a community report shows a case where a user's collections were deleted and had to be manually restored via support rather than self-service rollback. missing for 10: explicit version-history/rollback UI or API for collections/automations, first-party docs describing rollback workflow, and independent confirmation that rollback works reliably.
